_about: Public-domain Francis Jacox, Anglican clergyman and essayist, for the Word Hoard, his books on Scripture: Scripture Texts Illustrated by General Literature, Bible Music, Secular Annotations on Scripture Texts, Traits of Character and Notes of Incident in Bible Story, Scripture Proverbs, Side-Lights on Scripture Texts, and At Nightfall and Midnight. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 131 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jacox-side-lights: Side-lights on Scripture texts (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1877)
jacox-at-nightfall: At nightfall and midnight: musings after dark (catalogued 1873)
